result.summary: Several visual defects stand out: a popular restaurant card is missing its image (broken placeholder), a restaurant name is truncated mid-word, and the promo banner text has weak contrast on the green background.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in Popular right now shows only a broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant/food photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback illustration so the card is not visually empty.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the name remains readable.

issues.description: Secondary promo text ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is light green on a green banner, giving poor contrast and reduced readability.
issues.suggestion: Use white or a much lighter shade for the secondary line to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The notification bell badge (red dot) sits very close to the status bar and edge, risking a cramped or clipped appearance on some devices.
issues.suggestion: Add slightly more padding around the header icon so the badge has clear breathing room.
